command: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -qa app-tester "$d/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; then echo "RUNNING: $(basename $d): $(tr '\0' ' ' < $d/cmdline)"; fi; done; echo "done scan"
command_norm: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -qa app-tester "$d/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; then echo "RUNNING: $(basename $d): $(tr '\0' ' ' < $d/cmdline)"; fi; done; echo "done scan"
